header: I let the error log talk to PostgreSQL through one small function type (store.ts Query). TypeORM's own query() gives the rows of a SELECT or an INSERT ... RETURNING, but for an UPDATE or DELETE ... RETURNING it gives [rows, affectedCount]: this adapter turns both into plain rows.
